findings.current: he would not have left any gaps in the records
findings.defect: The Korean says he would not have left any gaps, without specifying that these would be gaps in records. The English adds a narrower, document-specific claim.
findings.rationale: The source says 빈틈을 남겨 두지 않았겠죠 (“would not have left any gaps”) after mentioning the risk of smuggling; it does not name records as the thing that would have no gaps.
findings.replacement: he would not have left any gaps

findings.defect: The source identifies the people he united as terrorists, not as followers. “Followers” adds an affiliation or loyalty implication.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 사분오열된 테러리스트들을 규합하여: he brought together the terrorists who had been split into factions.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful. Two small additions narrow or alter details in the account of the Prophet and the Magic Gem smuggling.
